name: Altacor
notes: Spray Drift Management: drift potential increases at wind speeds below 3 mph or above 10 mph (advisory wording). REI 4 hours. Tree Nuts (Crop Group 14-12): 2.0-4.5 oz/A, PHI 10 days, max 9 oz/A per calendar year. May not be applied within 100 feet of a water body. Rainfast time not stated.

name: Delegate WG
notes: Mandatory spray drift: do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site. REI 4 hours. Tree Nuts (Crop Group 14-12): up to 7 oz/A, PHI 1 day, max 28 oz/A per year, max 4 applications per year. No buffer distance stated. Rainfast time not stated.

name: Esteem Ant Bait
notes: Bait. REI 12 hours. Tree fruits and nuts: 1.5-2.0 lb/A. Do not apply within 24 hours of harvest (PHI 1 day). Avoid application if rain is expected within 4 to 6 hours (6 used). No wind limit, annual maximum or buffer stated.

name: Quash (Metconazole 50 WDG)
notes: Do not spray when wind velocity is less than 2 mph or more than 10 mph. Rainfast 2 hours. REI 12 hours. Tree Nuts except Filbert, Pecan and Pistachio: PHI 25 days, 3.5 oz/A, 14 oz/A per year; Pistachio: PHI 25 days, 4.0 oz/A, 16 oz/A per year (the stricter almond values are used). No buffer distance stated.

name: Intrepid 2F
notes: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 15 mph at the application site. REI 4 hours. Tree Nuts (Crop Group 14-12): PHI 7 days, max 24 fl oz/A per application, 64 fl oz/A per year. Do not apply by ground within 25 feet (air 150 feet) of lakes, reservoirs, rivers and other water bodies. Rainfastness: resists wash-off once dry; no hours stated.

name: Fontelis
notes: Drift potential is lowest in light to gentle sustained winds (2-10 mph) (advisory wording). Rainfast within 1 hour. REI 12 hours. Tree nuts plus pistachios: PHI 14 days, max 20 fl oz/A per application, 61 fl oz/A per year. No buffer distance stated.
